body:
## Expected Behavior

`tdbg m list-db` returns list of members from database

## Actual Behavior
```
$ tdbg m list-db
Error: unable to list Cluster Members: rpc error: code = InvalidArgument desc = host ID "" is not a valid UUID: invalid UUID length: 0
```

## Steps to Reproduce the Problem

  1. Upgrade to >= 1.30
  1. Run `tdbg m list-db`

This behavior was added in https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/8541. I've created https://github.com/temporalio/temporal/pull/10133 to fix it.

## Specifications

  - Version: >=v1.30
  - Platform: all
title: "tdbg m list-db" is broken on version >=1.30
